purpose: Trigger-first targeting: WHEN decides WHO. Discovery and outbound prioritization key off observable, dated, evidence-backed timing triggers instead of static ICP lists. 时机触发是获客的第一排序轴。

trigger_families.observable: job postings for roles that would own, use, or justify the capability
trigger_families.min_evidence: posting URL + role title + posting date

adapter_examples.CLO_FASHION_DPC: hiring 3D fashion designers / CLO artists / digital product creation leads

trigger_families.observable: new plant, line, office, or market-entry announcement

adapter_examples.INDUSTRIAL_3DP_BASE: new production line implies new jigs/fixtures/tooling demand
adapter_examples.CLOSET_3D_WORKSPACE: new design office / team implies collaboration and asset-versioning load

trigger_families.observable: exhibitor or attendee listing at a relevant trade fair
trigger_families.window_note: act from ~30 days before to ~14 days after the show; post-show follow-up references the concrete booth/talk
trigger_families.min_evidence: directory entry + show name + show date

adapter_examples.INDUSTRIAL_3DP_BASE: Formnext/TCT/AMUG exhibitor or industrial fair with prototyping needs
adapter_examples.CLO_FASHION_DPC: Kingpins/Premiere Vision/ISPO exhibitors with sampling-heavy lines

trigger_families.observable: new regulation or standard that changes cost/compliance of the current process
trigger_families.min_evidence: regulation reference + applicability claim for the account

adapter_examples.CLOFAB_FABRIC_DIGITIZATION: digital product passport / textile traceability requirements

trigger_families.observable: adoption or migration signals for adjacent/prerequisite technology

adapter_examples.INDUSTRIAL_3DP_BASE: CAD/PLM modernization; in-house prototyping lab build-out
adapter_examples.MD_CG_CLOTH: studio adopting new engine/pipeline needing cloth assets

trigger_families.observable: peer company or direct competitor publicly adopts a comparable capability
trigger_families.min_evidence: public adoption reference naming the peer

adapter_examples.CLO_FASHION_DPC: competitor cut sampling rounds with 3D design

trigger_families.observable: funding round, capex plan, or budget-cycle announcement
new hire/promotion into a decision-relevant role
trigger_families.min_evidence: role change source + role + date; person-level evidence stays person-level

adapter_examples.CLO_FASHION_DPC: new VP of product development / digital transformation lead

trigger_families.observable: disruption, reshoring, supplier failure, or lead-time crisis affecting the account
announced product line whose development consumes the capability

adapter_examples.INDUSTRIAL_3DP_BASE: new SKU family with fixture/tooling ramp
adapter_examples.MD_CG_CLOTH: announced game/film production with character wardrobe needs

activation.score_formula: score = sum(priority_weight * freshness_factor) over the account's active evidence-backed triggers
activation.no_trigger_rule: Fit-only accounts without any live trigger go to MONITOR_NURTURE watchlists; cold outbound without a dated trigger is below-standard practice in this system.

decay_rules: An expired trigger downgrades timing to UNKNOWN; it never becomes verified-negative.
Triggers are evidence-ledger claims: each carries source, observed date, and freshness; an undated trigger cannot activate outbound.
Trigger score orders the queue; it can never override a hard qualification gate.
discovery_recipe: For each adapter: (job-to-be-done keywords x trigger-family sources x territory language). Trade-show and hiring sources double as discovery source families, so trigger monitoring and universe building share infrastructure.
